parsePatch.name: modified
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/src/tracked.ts b/src/tracked.ts
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/tracked.ts
+++ b/src/tracked.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 one
-two
+TWO
 three

parsePatch.name: new-file
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/new.txt b/new.txt
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3333333
--- /dev/null
+++ b/new.txt
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+fresh
+lines

parsePatch.name: deleted
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/doomed.txt b/doomed.txt
deleted file mode 100644
index 3333333..0000000
--- a/doomed.txt
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1 +0,0 @@
-gone

parsePatch.name: rename-with-edit
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/old-name.txt b/new-name.txt
similarity index 66%
rename from old-name.txt
rename to new-name.txt
index 4444444..5555555 100644
--- a/old-name.txt
+++ b/new-name.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 rename me
 keep
+edited

parsePatch.name: binary
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/blob.dat b/blob.dat
index 6666666..7777777 100644
Binary files a/blob.dat and b/blob.dat differ

parsePatch.name: git-binary-patch
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/blob.dat b/blob.dat
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8888888
GIT binary patch
literal 6
bcmbtWI%(P+0RR91

literal 0
HcmV?d00001

parsePatch.name: no-newline
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/eof.txt b/eof.txt
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/eof.txt
+++ b/eof.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-tail
\ No newline at end of file
+tail!
\ No newline at end of file

parsePatch.name: multi-file
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/one.txt b/one.txt
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/one.txt
+++ b/one.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+b
diff --git a/two.txt b/two.txt
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3333333
--- /dev/null
+++ b/two.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+new

parsePatch.name: header-collision-in-hunk
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/comments.sql b/comments.sql
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/comments.sql
+++ b/comments.sql
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 SELECT 1
--- comment
+++ x
 SELECT 2

parsePatch.name: truncated-mid-hunk
parsePatch.patch:
diff --git a/big.txt b/big.txt

--- a/big.txt
+++ b/big.txt
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 ctx
-old
